svg.title: Ordering and fulfillment - actual services / State Pattern

g.text: Ordering and fulfillment - actual services / State Pattern
check grant / ACTIVE / bill request / lock session
snapshot locked menu recipe per OrderItem
lock stock rows by ascending ID
final template workflow / negative delta / order audit
Wrong role -> 403 ErrorResponse; X-User-Role is not authority.
Access denial happens before order status is written.
State singleton objects stay in service logic.
Entity stores enum; no Order.setState / Order.nextState.
Only the matching staff role may pass access-provider checks.
